content:
Apple is rolling out the second release candidates for macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, just one week after the first RC of macOS 26.7 publicly leaked multiple future product details.

macOS 26.7 and macOS 15.8 RC 2 now available

Developers can now install macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8 RC 2, arriving just days after the first macOS 26.7 candidate leaked multiple future product details—including a video and technical specifications of AirPods with cameras.

This release also arrives alongside macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 7, with public betas following shortly after.

Ironically, despite last week's leak, macOS 26.7 looks set to be a fairly uneventful release, as Apple is wrapping up major development on macOS 26 ahead of the macOS 27 Golden Gate launch in a few weeks. As for macOS Sequoia 15.8, it may include important security patches, some of which are expected to be included in macOS Tahoe 26.7.

That said, we're digging into the new code right now and will report back if we find anything noteworthy. The build number for macOS 26.7 RC 2 is 25G224, while the build number for macOS 15.8 is 24H20.

Have you spotted anything new in this RC? Drop it in the comments.
